toolsPreview.description: Screen a vendor, store, or group-buy (by name or URL) for legitimacy before paying. Returns a reputation read, a red-flag checklist (e.g. no MOQ disclosed, brand-new vendor), and Reddit community sentiment. Use this to assess scam/non-delivery risk for a hobby/collectibles purchase or group buy.
